position: Dispensing Nurse - LPN or RN - Per Diem - job post
description:
Description: 
  Who we are
 Since 1985 Brandywine Counseling & Community Services, Inc. (BCCS) has been a trusted provider of outstanding substance abuse and behavioral health treatment. BCCS is a community organization that prides itself on helping members of our community recover with dignity. We enhance the quality of life by creatively providing Education, Advocacy, Prevention, Early Intervention and Treatment Services. We promote hope and empowerment to persons and families touched by mental illness, substance abuse, HIV and multiple occurring diagnoses, and their related challenges.
 The Dispensing Nurse is responsible for creating a welcoming and healing environment by providing quality, sufficient and appropriate clinical services and maintaining high professional standards.
  As a Dispensing Nurse with BCCS, you will:
 
  Are primarily involved in dispensing methadone, a medication long known for its effectiveness in treating opiate addiction.
  Assists with Intake process
  Participates in treatment planning meetings.
  Follows-up on all medical referrals and records actions
  Facilitates detox entry with proper referral
  Requirements: 
  Qualifications for this position are:
 
  Currently licensed registered or practical nurse in the state of Delaware
 
  Schedule:
 
   Minimal requirement: 2 Saturdays per month - 05:30 a.m. - 09:30 a.m.
  Additional hours are available every day during dispensing time if the candidate is interested.
 
  Pay:
 
  LPN: Starting at $30/hour.
  RN: Starting at $40/hour.
